summary: Full Chrome-verified sweep for 2026-08-12 — no web-search-only fallback. All 39 roles were opened in Claude in Chrome and confirmed to be live postings with working deep links. Sources browser-verified this run: the Seek query battery (risk/compliance/audit/governance/CFO/CRO/COO/head-of/company-secretary/interim/contract plus the Board Appointments subclassification and Remote-AU terms), I Work for NSW (risk, governance, audit, CFO keyword searches), and the recruiter boards Kaizen, Bluefin and Michael Page; Robert Half was verified in the earlier pass. Robert Walters, Morgan McKinley and Sharp & Carter rendered but held nothing fresh and senior enough on-target on page one. The standouts are the Australasian Menopause Society Treasurer/Chair-of-FARC board seat and, for employment, two newly-created 'Head of' governance roles via Kaizen plus a cluster of NSW-government senior risk/assurance roles on I Work for NSW (Director Assurance at Sydney Trains, Senior Manager Procurement Risk/Audit and H&S Risk & Assurance at Transport for NSW, Associate Director Governance, Manager Audit & Assurance at the Reconstruction Authority) that fit the candidate's public-sector and utilities affinity. Coverage caveats: Board Direction is fully member-gated — every individual vacancy redirects to a members wall, so no verifiable per-role deep link exists and nothing from it was logged (a manual member login remains worthwhile); AICD Directorship Opportunities stays member-gated (teasers only); and Hays and Hudson were not reached within this run's time-box. The scheduled task is now Chrome-gated, so future automated runs will repeat this deep-link discipline and can pick up Hays/Hudson and any Board Direction teasers.
